summary: A flat roof module with a 0.4 m parapet for the HOUSE modular kit, covering one 3 x 3 m module. options parapet_front, parapet_back, parapet_right, parapet_left, pier_front_right, pier_front_left, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.house_roof_flat_parapet or place "prefab": "house_roof_flat_parapet" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
